contract_text: [VENDOR] Amendment to Support Services Agreement. Effective Date: April 1, 2026. The current term expires March 31, 2027. This amendment does not change the term. The agreement automatically renews for another one-year term unless either party gives written notice at least 60 days before expiration. Supplier will delete Customer Data within 30 days after termination. Supplier's liability for a data breach is unlimited.
